acceptance.scope: Finite controlled engineering targets, not general semantic accuracy or statistical significance

messages.text: Interrupted full-artifact uploads continue at the last confirmed offset; retransmitting the entire payload is unnecessary.
For thumbnail previews only, an interrupted upload discards partial bytes and starts a new payload.
Alder production accepts connections on port 4319 and allows 24 concurrent workers. This is the approved configuration.
Alder staging accepts connections on port 4318 and allows 16 concurrent workers. These settings do not apply to production.
A proposal for Alder production used port 9412 and 48 concurrent workers. The review rejected this proposal.
Juniper restoration uses recovery phrase WILLOW-73.
Deleted notebooks remain in recoverable quarantine for 21 days before irreversible erasure.
Notebook export downloads expire after 21 hours. This is not the retention period for deleted notebooks.
Schedule edits carry the version last read. A stale revision is rejected instead of overwriting the newer roster.
A proposal would let the last writer silently overwrite the on-call rota without checking versions. The review rejected that proposal.
While the remote sink is unavailable, the shipment worker spills queued batches to an encrypted disk spool. Its in-memory queue is bounded at 64 MiB.
The preview exporter drops queued preview batches when its endpoint is unavailable; it does not maintain a disk spool.
The approved Birch production request deadline is 850 ms.
The Birch staging request deadline is 8500 ms; staging is not the production configuration.
A proposed Birch production request deadline of 85 ms was rejected.
Sable cache entries are not copied between regions. Only invalidation events cross the regional boundary.
Sable audit logs are copied between regions. This rule concerns logs, not cached entries.
The Marlin restoration lead is Rina.
Marlin traffic may resume at 04:15 UTC after the restoration checks pass.
A Lumen courier package may contain at most 17 MiB of payload. The limit uses binary mebibytes.
A decimal limit of 17 MB for Lumen courier payloads was proposed and rejected.
The Vela archive recovery seal is HEATHER-86.
The Iris archive recovery seal is CLOVER-54.
Harness bootstrap: register the signature_check tool; send tool startup exceptions to storage responders.
Prism package authenticity failures belong to the provenance response team; storage responders are not the escalation owner.
Harness bootstrap: read-only tools are search_sessions, get_session, get_messages, get_chunks, and whoami. Routine heartbeat: the tool registry is ready.
